_comment: ANALYSE consumption of EPIC-PREP deferral obligations and COVERAGE keyed deferrals. Playbook phases 1, 2, 3, 4a, 5, 10. Verifier: analysis_verify.py --strict-principal. Upstream: docs/epic-prep-principal-contract.json, docs/coverage-principal-contract.json.

deferral_obligation_scan.ref_filter: obligations_proposed[] where kind == explicit_deferral OR disposition == deferral_candidate

coverage_deferral_scan.check_match: checks[] with obligation_ids[] containing deferral obligation id

work_queue_sources.scan: ref deferral obligations cross obligations_coverage.deferred_in_check and checks with obligation_ids
ref deferral obligation missing obligations_coverage row or status != deferred_in_check

delivery_principal_rules.action: delivery_known_fail and delivery_excluded gaps should include obligation_id from linked_obligation_ids when single id

forbidden_gaps.when: pointers.obligation_id is a ref deferral obligation with coverage deferred_in_check

deferred_in_check_legacy.applies_to: checks with calculation_contract deferred_ambiguous without keyed obligation_ids

strict_principal_verifier.skip_when_no_principal: ref has no deferral obligations and no verification_focus_proposed or principal_coverage_threads
rules: each ref deferral obligation id has deferred_check gap with pointers.obligation_id
each obligations_coverage deferred_in_check row has matching deferred_check gap
no obligation_uncovered gap for deferral obligation ids
delivery gaps for notes with linked_obligation_ids include obligation_id when single link
validation_log contains step 3-principal when ref has deferral obligations

TEST-DISCOVER.use: Fixture probe suppression and deferral ledger (Round 2 step 4)
